answer_1.quote: ...We evaluate models from three families of large language models... to assess cultural text adaptation... We utilize existing text corpora from the education domain... and additionally evaluate on dialogue and story domains (DailyDialog, ROCStories)...
answer_1.outputs: culturally adapted texts targeting the Indian cultural context

answer_2.quote: ...To quantify the extent of cultural adaptation in generated text, we introduce an Adaptation Score, which measures the correctness of cultural concept replacements...

answer_3.quote: ...We conduct our evaluation using two state-of-the-art LLMs: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Mistral 7B Instruct. Both models are employed to assess the quality of culturally adapted text based on a detailed prompt and scoring criteria...
methods: LLM-as-Judge scoring with Likert scale prompts

answer_4.quote: ...For human evaluation, we randomly sample 50 adapted generations for each of 7 models, totaling 350 instances... We assess the cultural adaptation... along Cultural Relevance dimension... Five annotators from diverse socio-demographic backgrounds... rate on a 6-point Likert scale...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate cultural relevance of each adapted text using a 0‑5 Likert scale, with detailed score descriptions provided as evaluation instructions.
